_about: Inputs for scripts/hero-frames.mjs (MVBOLD-29). focalX is in the clip's 1920px-wide pixel space. calm is the time, in seconds, at which the room is first complete (clutter gone, bins stacked, Dave's feet up); it drives the headline highlight and the logo. T2 (MVBOLD-33) replaced T1: the walls keep their own colour and only the light comes up. video.gop is the keyframe spacing: a seek decodes from the keyframe before it. trim is rows taken off the top and bottom of the clip: its first frames carry black rows along the top.
